description: Bounded media-applicability inventory for covered portal surfaces. This inventory records what is currently evidenced and leaves missing, broken/integrity-failed and no-image fallback claims open where executable rendered evidence does not yet exist.

surfaces.rationale: Authentication forms do not render repository-managed editorial media.
Password lifecycle forms do not render repository-managed editorial media.
The MFA provisioning QR code is security enrollment output, not EditorialMedia or Wiki content governed by this fallback contract.
Account provisioning state is rendered as text and controls without editorial-media consumption.
Character creation and public visibility flows do not consume repository-managed editorial media.
Current executable coverage proves composed text content and navigation; no managed image consumer is established for this surface.
Current CMS news and managed-page evidence does not establish a rendered managed-image contract.
Public game-data views render tabular and textual runtime data without repository-managed editorial media.
Core administration, RBAC, CMS metadata and audit views do not currently establish a rendered managed-image consumer.
Localization editing and route-preserving locale switching do not independently consume managed media.
Download artifacts are externally linked and explicitly not uploaded, fetched or proxied by the portal.
Current event module contract and browser evidence do not establish a repository-managed image field or rendered media consumer.
Announcements are escaped plain-text home composition and do not expose a managed-image contract.
Current support and legal content evidence establishes approved links and text content, not managed-image rendering.

markers: @wiki-media exact Wiki editor discovers inserts previews and publishes private EditorialMedia responsively

missing.reason: No rendered public-Wiki assertion currently proves the user-visible result when a referenced media record or content object is missing.

broken_or_integrity_failed.reason: HTTP integrity-failure coverage exists for supporting endpoints, but no rendered public-Wiki fallback assertion is currently bound.

no_image.reason: No explicit rendered assertion currently proves article layout when the article contains no image token.

missing.reason: No executable administrator-view assertion currently proves missing thumbnail or preview fallback behavior.

broken_or_integrity_failed.reason: Integrity rejection is covered at upload and endpoint layers, but the rendered Wiki editor fallback is not asserted.

no_image.reason: No explicit rendered assertion currently proves editor and preview layout with no selected or embedded image.

markers: @portal-editorial-media manager validates, uploads, privately previews, protects references, deletes and audits

missing.reason: No rendered media-library assertion currently proves the visible fallback for a missing stored object.

broken_or_integrity_failed.reason: Upload integrity rejection is evidenced, but an already-listed corrupt object and its rendered fallback are not.

no_image.reason: The empty library state is declared in portal coverage but is not yet bound here to an exact browser marker.

surfaces.rationale: These routes deliver protected content, thumbnails and signed previews. Their HTTP authorization and integrity behavior supports, but does not substitute for, rendered fallback evidence on consuming Wiki and EditorialMedia surfaces.

nonclaims: This inventory does not prove all required rendered fallback states.
Supporting endpoint responses are not treated as visible fallback UX evidence.
Parent Issue #326 remains open for the remaining state matrix.
No staging, production or Canary behavior is claimed.
